summary: Iteration 41 — All 5 Actionable Portfolio UX enhancements verified end-to-end on priyanka's 64-holding live portfolio. resolveAlertCta() lowercases alert.component so 'Diversification' and 'Cost' (with capitals from backend) map correctly to the diversification/cost branches.
ActionablePortfolioView.js is at 664 lines — approaching the 700-line threshold flagged in iteration 40. Future refactor to extract ImpactStrip + AlertCTA + RowBody sub-components would help.
